TermsPage.title: Terms and conditions
TermsPage.intro: These terms are a starting point and will be finalized before the site's official launch.
TermsPage.section1Body: By booking a motorcycle with XOPA Moto Rental, you agree to use it responsibly, follow Panama's traffic laws, and return it in the condition you received it, allowing for normal wear.
TermsPage.section2Body: The rider must be 21 or older, present a valid motorcycle license and a valid ID.
TermsPage.section3Body: A refundable security deposit is required. It's returned in full at the end of the rental if the bike is returned undamaged.
TermsPage.section4Body: Cancellation and refund conditions are confirmed at the time of booking online.
TermsPage.section5Body: For any questions about these terms, write to us at xopamotorental@gmail.com.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This policy is a starting point and will be finalized before the site's official launch.
PrivacyPage.section1Body: When you book or contact us, we collect your name, phone number and email to manage your rental and respond to you.
PrivacyPage.section2Body: We use your data only to coordinate the booking, payment and support during your rental. We never sell it to third parties.
PrivacyPage.section3Body: If you message us on WhatsApp, that conversation is handled through Meta/WhatsApp under its own privacy policy.
PrivacyPage.section4Body: To review, correct or delete your data, write to us at xopamotorental@gmail.com.
